systems.title: Combat stances and weapon swap
systems.summary: Fighters drop into a guard stance when they pick a target, swing in turn, flinch when struck, and can change the weapon in their hand without a new body.

sections.heading: Moving
sections.body: Out of a fight a character stands, walks and runs in a relaxed way. Walking and running loop smoothly for as long as the character keeps moving.

sections.heading: Fighting stance
sections.body: The moment a fighter has a target, the guard comes up: the knees bend, the sword lifts and the shield comes up in front, covering the body the way a real guard does. The face stays in view over the shield rim. When the fight ends, the fighter relaxes and goes back to standing.

sections.heading: Attack, block, hit
sections.body: A fighter with several attacks swings them in turn: first, second, third, then back to the first. After each swing the guard comes back up. A block holds the shield high for as long as it lasts. A hit plays a short flinch, then the fighter returns to guard. A fallen fighter stays down.

sections.heading: Swapping weapons
sections.body: The same body can take a different weapon in hand while the game runs. The last picture shows the spear swapped for an axe, with every move still working.

limits: The server does not send attack or block yet, so those show only in the preview and the render. The hit flinch only plays on fighters that use this body, and the watch sergeant is not standing in the live game yet, so for now you see the flinch in the preview and the render.
Only the Lantern Hollow watch sergeant uses this body today.
